task: Summarise the supplied notice in exactly two bullet points. Include the closure date and reopening time. Do not add facts.
source: The town library will be closed on Monday 12 October 2026 for maintenance. It will reopen at 9 am on Tuesday 13 October 2026. Online services remain available.
response_a:
- The town library is closed on Monday 12 October 2026 for maintenance.
- It reopens at 9 am on Tuesday 13 October 2026; online services remain available.
response_b: The library is closed all week for renovations. It reopens next Monday at 10 am. Members will receive a refund.

B.unsupported_claims: Closure duration, reopening details and refunds are unsupported or contradicted.

rationale: A is preferred because it follows the two-bullet format and accurately includes the closure date and reopening time. B changes the closure to a full week, gives an incorrect reopening day and time, and invents a refund. It also ignores the requested bullet format. A is grounded in the notice and includes both required details.
